policy_values_tam: F01 (OD-008 / Security Owner): reset, suspend and activate require the actor to hold every permission of every unexpired grant of the target (including grants not yet started) in a covering scope (can_delegate_role per permission).
F03: a pending account cannot change status through PATCH /admin/users/{id}/status (409 INVITATION_REQUIRED); activation is only from suspended/locked and resets failed_login_count/locked_until.
F05 (Security Owner lockout policy): a failed-login lockout blocks new logins only; sessions of a locked account stay valid; suspended/pending accounts remain rejected.

F06 (OD-007/OD-008): self-grant denied (403 SELF_GRANT_DENIED); delegated valid_until may not exceed the latest expiry of the delegator's covering grants for every role permission plus user:grant_role; omitted valid_until defaults to that cap; larger value → 422.
F07 (OD-004 measurement): PASSWORD_HASH_CONCURRENCY = 4 Argon2id operations per event loop (64 MB each).
behavior_changes_for_reviewer: Pending accounts can no longer be suspended via the status endpoint; this closes the pending → suspended → active → admin-chosen-password path. Cancelling an invitation now has no API path (A0102-F10, P3, out of scope).
GET /auth/me returns status 'locked' for a locked account that still holds a valid session.
Grant responses may carry a non-null valid_until even when the request omitted it (delegator's cap).
invitation_accept and password_reset_accept audits gain extra_data.issued_by.

New error codes: TARGET_PRIVILEGE_EXCEEDS_ACTOR (403), INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION (409), SELF_GRANT_DENIED (403), ROLE_VALIDITY_EXCEEDS_DELEGATOR (422); INVITATION_REQUIRED (409) reused for status changes. OpenAPI schema unchanged.
backend/pyproject.toml declares anyio==4.16.0 (already pinned in requirements.lock) because services.py imports it directly.
